diff --git a/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_aix.py b/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_aix.py

index 0000000..d3405b4

+++ b/test/units/module_utils/facts/hardware/test_aix.py
@@ -0,0 +1,67 @@
+# This file is part of Ansible
+#
+# Ansible is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
+# it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
+# the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
+# (at your option) any later version.
+
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import Mock
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.aix import AIXHardware
+
+
+def test_get_cpu_facts():
+    devices = '\n'.join('proc%s Available 00-00 Processor' % i for i in range(12))
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, devices, ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (0, 'smt_threads 4 SMT threads False\n', ''),
+    ]
+
+    facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+    assert facts == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 12,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 4,
+        'processor_vcpus': 48,
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[1][0][0] == '/usr/sbin/lsattr -El proc0 -a type'
+
+
+def test_get_cpu_facts_without_smt_threads():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'proc0   Available 00-00 Processor\nproc1 Defined 00-01 Processor\n', ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (0, '', ''),
+    ]
+
+    facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+    assert facts['processor_cores'] == 1
+    assert facts['processor_threads_per_core'] == 1
+    assert facts['processor_vcpus'] == 1
+    assert facts['processor_count'] == 1
+    assert facts['processor'] == ['PowerPC_POWER7']
+
+
+def test_get_cpu_facts_without_available_processors():
+    module = Mock()
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'proc0 Defined 00-00 Processor\n', '')
+
+    facts = AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts()
+
+    assert facts == {
+        'processor': [],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 0,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 1,
+        'processor_vcpus': 0,
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_count == 1
